description: Zodiacal releasing (aphesis), the Hellenistic time-lord technique from Vettius Valens, released from a Lot (Spirit by default, or Fortune). From the Lot's sign, periods release sign by sign with planetary minor-year lengths on the 360-day-year convention; each level is a twelfth of the one above (L1..L4), and a loop back to the starting sign looses the bond, jumping once to the opposite sign (+6). Returns the timeline down to max_level over the horizon and, when target_date is given, the L1..L4 lords active then. Anchored to the natal Lot, so an exact time and lat+lon are required.

date.description: UTC date-time, ISO 8601, e.g. 1990-06-10T14:30:00Z. Convert local birth time to UTC first.

horizon_years.description: timeline length in 360-day years from birth (default 100)

lot.description: the Lot to release from (default spirit)

max_level.description: deepest sub-period level in the timeline, 1..4 (default 2)

target_date.description: UTC ISO date to read the active L1..L4 periods for; omit for the timeline only

name: releasing
